kyoto.name: Kyoto
kyoto.tagline: Lantern-lit alleys, quiet gardens, and a slower kind of luxury.

stays.name: Machiya Lantern House
stays.blurb: A restored 1920s townhouse with cedar soaking tubs, a tiny courtyard garden, and a private entrance onto the Pontocho lantern alley.

stays.name: Higashiyama Mist Ryokan
stays.blurb: Nine suites arranged around a moss garden, with kaiseki breakfast and a bath that looks straight into the maple canopy.

stays.name: Nishiki Kitchen Loft
stays.blurb: A compact chef's loft above the market with a copper counter, market credit, and a pocket guide to the vendors who open at 6am.

experiences.name: Kaiseki counter with Chef Mori
experiences.blurb: Eight seasonal courses at a six-seat counter, built around the morning's Nishiki Market delivery.

experiences.name: Pontocho after dark
experiences.blurb: A resident-led walk through the lantern alleys, teahouse history, and the riverbank where the city unwinds.

dining.name: Kamo River Yudofu
dining.blurb: Silken tofu simmered in kombu dashi, served on a riverside veranda with yuzu kosho and seasonal pickles.

lisbon.name: Lisbon
lisbon.tagline: Tiled hills, salt-air taverns, and the best light in Europe.

stays.name: Casa do Azulejo
stays.blurb: A 1760s townhouse wrapped in hand-painted tiles, with a rooftop kitchen and views across the Tejo.

stays.name: Bica Light Studio
stays.blurb: A sunlit studio above a neighborhood bakery, with a Juliet balcony and a very good reason to wake up early.

stays.name: Estrela Garden Suites
stays.blurb: Twelve suites opening onto a walled garden, a short tram ride from the river and a long way from the crowds.

experiences.name: Mercado da Ribeira chef's table
experiences.blurb: Shop the market with a chef, then cook a four-course Portuguese lunch in a private kitchen above the stalls.

experiences.name: Sunset tram & fado
experiences.blurb: Ride a restored tram to Graça, then settle into a tiny fado house for a glass of vinho verde.

dining.name: Taberna do Beco
dining.blurb: Bacalhau à Brás tangled with shoestring potatoes and olives, served at a six-table taverna in a tiled alley.

copenhagen.name: Copenhagen
copenhagen.tagline: Harbor light, rye bread, and design you can live in.

stays.name: Havn Studio
stays.blurb: A pale-oak loft above a bakery on the lake, with bikes, a record player, and a very serious coffee setup.

stays.name: Kanal House
stays.blurb: Forty rooms in a converted grain warehouse, with a floating sauna and breakfast on the canal deck.

experiences.name: Rye & fire bakery morning
experiences.blurb: Shape rye, laminate pastry, and eat still-warm cardamom buns with the bakers who start at 4am.

experiences.name: Design walk with a local curator
experiences.blurb: A curator's route through independent studios, a furniture archive, and the best coffee in the design district.

dining.name: Bord & Brød
dining.blurb: Open-faced rye with pickled herring, smoked egg, and dill oil, in a dining room that feels like a very good friend's apartment.

oaxaca.name: Oaxaca
oaxaca.tagline: Smoke, chocolate, and color in every courtyard.

stays.name: Casa Cacao
stays.blurb: A magenta courtyard house with a cacao bar, six rooms, and a rooftop that catches the evening bell from Santo Domingo.

stays.name: Ruta del Mezcal House
stays.blurb: Four rooms around a jacaranda tree, with a mezcal tasting room and a resident dog named Mole.

experiences.name: Mercado 20 de Noviembre at dawn
experiences.blurb: Drink tejate with the market cooks, taste three moles, and learn which chile goes home with you.

experiences.name: Natural-dye textile studio
experiences.blurb: Work with cochineal, indigo, and marigold in a family studio, then dye a scarf to take home.

dining.name: Humo & Maíz
dining.blurb: Tlayudas crisped over mesquite, with black beans, quesillo, and a salsa flight that starts mild and ends in a story.
dining.signature_dish: Tlayuda with black beans and quesillo

seoul.name: Seoul
seoul.tagline: Hanok roofs, neon alleys, and a city that never stops simmering.

stays.name: Hanok Steam House
stays.blurb: A 1930s hanok with ondol floors, a persimmon tree, and a breakfast table that fills up with banchan.

stays.name: Riverlight Hotel
stays.blurb: Floor-to-ceiling windows over the Han, a rooftop bath, and a lobby that smells faintly of pine.

experiences.name: Gwangjang market night crawl
experiences.blurb: Bindaetteok, mayak gimbap, and a table-side lesson in how to order like a regular.

experiences.name: Moon jar ceramics studio
experiences.blurb: Throw a small moon jar in a Bukchon studio, then walk the ridge to a tea house with your still-wet work.

dining.name: Simmer House
dining.blurb: Kimchi jjigae bubbling in a stone pot, with rice, seaweed, and a rotating cast of banchan.

amalfi.name: Amalfi Coast
amalfi.tagline: Lemon groves, vertigo views, and long lunches by the water.

stays.name: Villa Limone
stays.blurb: A terraced villa in a lemon grove, with a sea-facing pool and a kitchen that opens to the evening air.

stays.name: Salt & Stone Rooms
stays.blurb: Eight whitewashed rooms above the harbor, with a breakfast terrace and a very short walk to the ferry.

experiences.name: Lemon terrace pasta lesson
experiences.blurb: Hand-cut tagliolini with lemons picked ten steps away, taught by a nonna with strong opinions about butter.

experiences.name: Gozzo sunset sail
experiences.blurb: A wooden gozzo, a bottle of Falanghina, and the coastline turning gold from Praiano to Positano.

dining.name: Terrazza Limone
dining.blurb: Lemon spaghetti tangled with bottarga and zucchini blossoms, served under a pergola of vines.

marrakech.name: Marrakech
marrakech.tagline: Courtyards, spice, and the Atlas Mountains at the end of the street.

stays.name: Riad Zellige
stays.blurb: Seven rooms around a tiled courtyard, with a plunge pool, a rooftop breakfast, and a hammam downstairs.

stays.name: Atlas Garden Retreat
stays.blurb: An olive-grove estate with twelve suites, a long pool, and the Atlas Mountains doing the decorating.

experiences.name: Spice souk & tagine workshop
experiences.blurb: Build a ras el hanout from the souk, then slow-cook a tagine in a riad kitchen while it rains outside (or doesn't).

experiences.name: Atlas day with a Berber guide
experiences.blurb: A valley walk, mint tea with a family, and a picnic above the tree line with a guide who knows every switchback.

dining.name: Dar Saffron
dining.blurb: Apricot and almond tagine, saffron rice, and a courtyard that stays cool until the lanterns come on.

vancouver.name: Vancouver
vancouver.tagline: Rainforest on one side, Pacific on the other, dinner in between.

stays.name: Pier 7 Loft
stays.blurb: A timber loft over the market with a crab pot, a record player, and a water taxi stop at the door.

stays.name: Forest Edge House
stays.blurb: A cedar house at the trailhead, with a wood-fired tub, floor-to-ceiling forest, and no reason to hurry.

experiences.name: Temperate rainforest forage
experiences.blurb: Forage mushrooms, salal, and sea asparagus with a chef-guide, then cook it all over a driftwood fire.

experiences.name: Spot prawn boat & shucking lesson
experiences.blurb: Head out at golden hour, pull traps with a commercial fisher, and eat prawns within minutes of landing.

dining.name: Tide & Cedar
dining.blurb: Spot prawns grilled over cedar, with sea asparagus, cultured butter, and a view of the harbour lights.
